subject.title: Feature: Support custom anthropic_beta flags in Bedrock model config

question: Should Amazon Bedrock expose a broad `additionalModelRequestFields` or `providerFields` passthrough, a narrower typed `anthropicBeta` or `context1m` option, or no user-configurable beta flags?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but any fix adds a public Bedrock provider config contract and repository policy treats provider routing and config/default surfaces as compatibility-sensitive maintainer decisions.

options.title: Add Validated Bedrock Request Fields
options.body: Expose a Bedrock-owned per-model or plugin config contract that safely merges validated request fields and covers `anthropic_beta` without moving generic provider policy into core.

options.title: Add Only Typed Beta Support
options.body: Support a narrow Bedrock `anthropicBeta` or `context1m` path for Claude long context while avoiding a general Converse body passthrough.

options.title: Decline Custom Betas
options.body: Keep Bedrock request shaping internal and require first-class provider support for each beta feature as it appears.

recommendation.title: Add Validated Bedrock Request Fields
recommendation.body: Expose a Bedrock-owned per-model or plugin config contract that safely merges validated request fields and covers `anthropic_beta` without moving generic provider policy into core.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans provider plugin ownership and config-contract policy, and recent history shows repeated Bedrock and Claude provider boundary work.
